data.content_ref: inline:CONTRADICTS: The 024cbd0e1e4f census delta contradicts the foundational assumption (shared by SRC_001–SRC_005) that all six gaps are independent defects ranked by blast radius. Instead, the observability discrepancy in verify_root_report is a symptom of the same routing-rot mechanism described in SRC_003: resolve_conjecture_route and compile_criticism_assignments are unimported, and one of them is responsible for feeding version metadata to verify_root_report, so the routing decay causes pre-v6 roots to arrive at verify_root_report with missing or default version fields, which then get verdict-pathed instead of error-pathed. This unifies Priority 3 and Priority 6 into a single causal chain. This is REFUTED IF verify_root_report does not depend on resolve_conjecture_route or compile_criticism_assignments for its version-metadata input — i.e., it reads root version directly from storage — or if the census delta persists even when both routing functions are confirmed importable and callable.
